messages:
arjun: Heads-up 1:20 sales flagged a recurring ask from three mid-market accounts: they want a predictable monthly "priority burst" addon that stays within their committed spend band. Can we sketch options?

leah: Are they asking to have burst count against commit or be billed as an explicit addon? Those are very different contract/legal flows.

mike: AE said they prefer "count towards commit" if possible, but only up to a defined cap per month. Beyond cap -> addon billing.

claudia: From eng/sched side: we can implement a tenant-level priority token that routes requests ahead of baseline, but we need a hard cap to avoid starving Dedicated/reserved customers.

arjun: Goal: three concrete proposals for GTM and legal to review. My quick draft:
1) Addon-billed model: burst is metered separately at a fixed per-token rate; no commit mixing. Simple billing.
2) Hybrid-credited model: burst consumption is first deducted from a small monthly credit bucket (prepaid addon) that counts as part of commit up to cap N tokens; over-cap -> billed as addon. Negotiable for top-tier accounts.
3) Commit-applied-with-cap: allow burst consumption to temporarily draw from commit headroom but automatically reconcile monthly and apply an overage if net > commit + cap. Complex.

leah: For negotiation playbook, recommend standard = option #1, pilot = option #2 for selected accounts, enterprise-only = option #3 with bespoke SLAs. Keeps sales leverage.

mike: We need precise metrics for launch: 
- pilot with 2 customers for 30d
- per-tenant peak token cap enforced server-side
- telemetry: per-tenant priority-hit-rate, fallback-rate, p99 latency delta

claudia: Ops asks for a routing policy snippet. Example to align product/legal:```
priority_policy: 
  preference: pool_priority
  quota: tenant_priority_quota
  fallback: shared_pool
  enforcement: hard_cap_per_minute
```

arjun: Contract sketch for legal (language is intentionally loose to iterate): "Customer may purchase Priority Burst addon. Priority Burst provides preferential routing to a priority processing lane up to the Customer's monthly Priority Cap. Use beyond the monthly Priority Cap will be billed at the Priority Overage Rate and will not reduce or re-allocate the Customer's Reserved Capacity unless explicitly agreed in writing."

leah: Billing mapping: important to choose between "credits" (prepaid bucket) or direct per-token metering. Credits simplify sales comps but complicate meter reconciliation. Recommend offering both but default to per-token addon.

billing-bot: FYI: pricing SKU needs a unique sku_id before PR can be merged. Please file internal billing item.

mike: UX/console needs: tenant toggle + view of monthly cap + warning banner when >80% cap + quick downgrade flow.

claudia: Ops note: initial safe per-tenant burst cap estimate = 250k tokens/min until perf validated. We'll test at 100% load in canary.

arjun: Action items: @leah prepare negotiation playbook + standard/legal language by Wed EOD; @mike mock console wireframe by Thu; @claudia schedule perf canary and confirm burst cap by Fri; @billing-bot file sku request. We'll decide pilot cohort Thurs 2pm. :sparkles:
